java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size, 66% of the container memory, leaving room for metaspace, code cache, threads and direct buffers

deployment.description: Stateless: no timers or background jobs, every request is independent, so replicas can be added freely.

kong.description: Default timeouts. Report exports and uploads answer only when finished and take longer with larger date ranges and reports, so very large ones can exceed the read timeout. Raise it if they do, keeping the sidecar's REQUEST_TIMEOUT (in milliseconds, 60000 when unset) at least as high.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL host for writes and, unless a read-only replica is configured, for reads.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL port; the database client uses 5432 when unset.

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL user that owns the tenant schemas, supplied through secret management.

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the PostgreSQL user, supplied through secret management.

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database that holds the tenant schemas.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER
EnvVars.description: Host of a synchronously replicated read-only replica for read queries, which the write instance must list in synchronous_standby_names; takes effect only together with DB_PORT_READER, otherwise reads go to DB_HOST.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER
EnvVars.description: Port of the synchronously replicated read-only replica; takes effect only together with DB_HOST_READER.

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: PEM certificate or certificate chain to verify the PostgreSQL server; when set, connections require TLS 1.3 and hostname verification, when unset they are unencrypted.

EnvVars.name: DB_QUERYTIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Query timeout in milliseconds that RMB applies only when the module passes it to a query; this module does not, so the setting has no effect.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of concurrent database connections per tenant in one module instance.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of concurrent database connections in one module instance, shared by all tenants; when set, DB_MAXPOOLSIZE is ignored and one tenant can block others, so leave it unset unless that is wanted.

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Milliseconds after which an idle database connection is closed; 0 keeps idle connections open.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum lifetime of a database connection in milliseconds, after which it is closed once idle; 0 means unlimited.

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of retries after a failed database connection attempt; 0 disables reconnecting.

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Milliseconds between database reconnection attempts; relevant only when reconnecting is enabled.

EnvVars.name: DB_EXPLAIN_QUERY_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Query duration in milliseconds above which RMB logs an EXPLAIN ANALYZE of searches; raise it to reduce the extra load.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_HTTP_LIMITS_MAX_BODY_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum request body size the sidecar accepts, raised from the 10 MB default to the module's own 200 MB upload limit because COUNTER report uploads exceed 10 MB.
